name: Bishnupriya Manipuri
caution: 0.4 million words, versus hundreds of millions for the main languages. Frequency values are unreliable, so there are no frequency bands, only the all-words generators. The reference lexicon has 5,745 words, so generators, neighbourhood measures and cluster filters are rougher than for the main languages. 5,745 of the reference words come from a Wikipedia corpus (Leipzig Corpora Collection, bpy_wikipedia_2021_30K, 0.4 million words); no subtitle list exists for this language. Written sources are more formal than subtitles and contain more names and foreign words. All frequencies come from that corpus, so no frequency bands are offered. Bishnupriya is written in the Bengali–Assamese script: CV (orthographic) counts every consonant letter as C plus an inherent vowel V unless a vowel sign or virama follows; anusvara is C. Inherent-vowel deletion is not modelled. Length is counted in aksharas.

source: Leipzig Corpora Collection word list bpy_wikipedia_2021_30K (CC BY; Goldhahn, Eckart & Quasthoff 2012)

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: number of training words, between 5000 and 40000
